name: PCI DSS
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard. Paddock evidences network segmentation (Sentry), vulnerability identification and remediation, and inventories. It is not an Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) and does not perform penetration tests.

controls.title: Accurate network diagram(s) maintained
controls.summary: Diagrams show all connections between the CDE and other networks, including wireless.
controls.rationale: Sentry's observed segmentation map shows which segments actually reach which. It corroborates, but is not, the documented network diagram.
controls.attestation: Provide the maintained network diagram and evidence of its review.

controls.title: Allowed services, protocols and ports are identified and approved
controls.summary: Every allowed service, protocol and port has a defined business need.
controls.rationale: Paddock inventories exposed ports/services and flags unnecessary exposure; business-need approval is organisational.
controls.attestation: Provide the approved ports/services list with business justification.

controls.title: Security features defined for insecure services and protocols
controls.summary: Insecure services, protocols and ports in use have defined, implemented security features.
controls.rationale: Sentry and TLS checks detect cleartext management and weak transport in use.
controls.attestation: Document the compensating security features for any insecure protocol that remains.

controls.title: Inbound traffic to the CDE is restricted
controls.summary: Only necessary inbound traffic to the cardholder data environment is allowed.
controls.rationale: Observed reachability between segments and segment-crossing detections show whether restrictions hold in practice. Firewall rulesets themselves are not read.
controls.attestation: Provide NSC rulesets for the CDE boundary.

controls.title: Outbound traffic from the CDE is restricted
controls.summary: Only necessary outbound traffic from the CDE is allowed.
controls.rationale: Sentry flags unexpected internet egress and cross-segment initiation by devices.
controls.attestation: Provide outbound NSC rules for the CDE.

controls.title: NSCs between trusted and untrusted networks
controls.summary: Network security controls are implemented between trusted and untrusted networks.
controls.rationale: External scanning shows what is reachable from the internet; Sentry shows OT/IoT on public addresses.
controls.attestation: Provide NSC configuration standards and rulesets.

controls.title: Only necessary services and functions are enabled
controls.summary: Unnecessary services, protocols, daemons and functions are removed or disabled.
controls.rationale: Exposed files, development hosts on the internet, and unnecessary services surface as findings.

controls.title: Non-console administrative access is encrypted
controls.summary: All non-console administrative access uses strong cryptography.
controls.rationale: Telnet/FTP/SNMPv1-2c management and weak TLS are detected where observed; access paths Paddock cannot see are not covered.
controls.attestation: Confirm administrative access methods for all CDE components.

controls.title: Strong cryptography and valid certificates on open networks
controls.summary: PAN transmitted over open, public networks uses strong cryptography with valid, unexpired certificates.
controls.rationale: TLS grades and certificate expiry tracking evidence the transport configuration of observed endpoints; which endpoints carry PAN is organisational.
controls.attestation: Identify the endpoints that transmit PAN.

controls.title: Inventory of trusted keys and certificates
controls.summary: An inventory of trusted keys and certificates used to protect PAN in transit is maintained.
controls.rationale: Paddock inventories public certificates (CT logs, TLS handshakes). Private keys and internal PKI are out of view.
controls.attestation: Provide the key and certificate inventory for internal PKI.

controls.title: Software engineering techniques prevent common attacks
controls.summary: Bespoke software is developed with techniques that prevent common software attacks.
controls.rationale: SAST taint analysis and secret scanning evidence some techniques; secure-design and review practices are organisational.
controls.attestation: Provide secure-development procedures and code-review records.

controls.title: Vulnerabilities are identified and risk-ranked
controls.summary: New vulnerabilities are identified from industry sources and assigned a risk ranking.
controls.rationale: Findings are matched to NVD/OSV, ranked by severity with EPSS and CISA KEV, and enriched with threat intelligence.

controls.title: Inventory of bespoke and third-party software components
controls.summary: An inventory of bespoke and custom software and third-party components is maintained.
controls.rationale: Paddock builds an SBOM from lockfiles and keeps it current per project.

controls.title: Known vulnerabilities are patched in time
controls.summary: Critical security patches are installed within one month of release; others within defined periods.
controls.rationale: Remediation SLAs (critical 24h by default) are measured per finding; open criticals past SLA and open KEV vulnerabilities are gaps.

controls.title: Audit logs are enabled and active
controls.summary: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data.
controls.rationale: Paddock's own hash-chained audit log covers actions in Paddock only, not CDE system components.
controls.attestation: Provide audit-log configuration for CDE system components.

controls.title: Authorized and unauthorized wireless access points are managed
controls.summary: Wireless access points are identified and unauthorized ones detected at least quarterly.
controls.rationale: Sentry identifies devices on mirrored segments, including access points it can fingerprint; it is not an RF wireless scan.
controls.attestation: Provide quarterly wireless scan results or WIDS/WIPS records.

controls.title: Internal vulnerability scans at least quarterly
controls.summary: Internal scans run at least every three months; high-risk and critical vulnerabilities are resolved and rescanned.
controls.rationale: Paddock's internal view is passive (Sentry) and agent inventory based; it supplements but does not replace authenticated internal scanning.
controls.attestation: Provide quarterly internal scan reports and rescan evidence.

controls.title: External vulnerability scans at least quarterly
controls.summary: External scans run at least every three months by a PCI SSC Approved Scanning Vendor, with passing results.
controls.rationale: Paddock scans the external surface continuously and shows remediation, but it is not an ASV; ASV scan reports are still required.
controls.attestation: Provide four quarters of passing ASV scan reports.

controls.title: External scans after any significant change
controls.summary: External scans are performed after significant changes and high-risk findings resolved.
controls.rationale: Surface-change detection and scheduled rescans show the surface is rescanned as it changes.
controls.attestation: Map significant changes to the post-change scans.

controls.title: Penetration testing methodology defined and followed
controls.summary: A penetration testing methodology is defined, documented and implemented.
controls.rationale: Paddock is a defensive tool and does not perform penetration tests.
controls.attestation: Provide the penetration-testing methodology and most recent reports.

controls.title: Segmentation controls are tested
controls.summary: If segmentation reduces scope, its effectiveness is confirmed by penetration testing at least every 12 months and after changes.
controls.rationale: Sentry continuously observes which segments actually reach each other and flags crossings. That is strong supporting evidence between tests, but the requirement calls for a penetration test.
controls.attestation: Provide the segmentation penetration-test report (annual and after changes).

controls.title: Intrusion detection at the CDE perimeter and critical points
controls.summary: Intrusion-detection and/or -prevention techniques detect and alert on intrusions.
controls.rationale: Sentry's passive behaviour detectors alert on lateral scanning and anomalous device traffic; they are not a full signature-based IDS.
controls.attestation: Provide IDS/IPS deployment and alerting evidence.

controls.title: Inventory of in-scope system components
controls.summary: An inventory of system components in scope for PCI DSS is maintained and kept current.
controls.rationale: Paddock's discovered and observed inventory is current; which components are in PCI scope is decided by the organisation.
controls.attestation: Mark the in-scope components and confirm the inventory.

controls.title: PCI DSS scope documented and confirmed annually
controls.summary: Scope is documented and confirmed at least every 12 months and after significant change.
controls.rationale: Scope confirmation is an organisational activity; Paddock's inventory and segmentation map are inputs.
controls.attestation: Provide the annual scope confirmation.

controls.title: Incident response plan exists
controls.summary: An incident response plan is in place and ready to be activated.
controls.rationale: Organisational.
controls.attestation: Provide the incident response plan and last test.
